name: Volt Typhoon – APT Threat Map
description: Técnicas de Volt Typhoon com cobertura do catálogo (score 3=regra, 2=parcial, 1=lacuna)

techniques.comment: Volt Typhoon has attempted to access hashed credentials from the LSASS process memory space. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has used ntds.util to create domain controller installation media containing usernames and password hashes. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has stolen files from a sensitive file server and the Active Directory database from targeted environments, and used Wevtutil to extract event log information. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has executed the Windows-native `vssadmin` command to create volume shadow copies. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has used `net start` to list running services. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has collected window title information from compromised systems. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has queried the Registry on compromised systems, `reg query hklm\software\`, for information on installed software including PuTTY. | cobertura: regra

Volt Typhoon has executed multiple commands to enumerate network topology and settings including `ipconfig`, `netsh interface firewall show all`, and `netsh interface portproxy show all`. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has employed Ping to check network connectivity. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has used multiple methods, including Ping, to enumerate systems on compromised networks. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has moved laterally to the Domain Controller via RDP using a compromised account with domain administrator privileges. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has used the Ultimate Packer for Executables (UPX) to obfuscate the FRP client files BrightmetricAgent.exe and SMSvcService.ex) and the port scanning utility ScanLine. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has used public tools and executed the PowerShell command `Get-EventLog security -instanceid 4624` to identify associated user and computer account names. | cobertura: regra

Volt Typhoon has used legitimate looking filenames for compressed copies of the ntds.dit database and used names including cisco_up.exe, cl64.exe, vm3dservice.exe, watchdogd.exe, Win.exe, WmiPreSV.exe, and WmiPrvSE.exe for the Earthworm and Fast Reverse Proxy tools. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has appended copies of the ntds.dit database with a .gif file extension. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has used commercial tools, LOTL utilities, and appliances already present on the system for network service discovery. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has leveraged WMIC for execution, remote system discovery, and to create and use temporary directories. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has used `netstat -ano` on compromised hosts to enumerate network connections. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has created and accessed a file named rult3uil.log on compromised domain controllers to capture keypresses and command execution. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has enumerated running processes on targeted systems including through the use of Tasklist. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has used PowerShell including for remote system discovery. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has used the Windows command line to perform hands-on-keyboard activities in targeted environments including for discovery. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has used Brightmetricagent.exe which contains a command- line interface (CLI) library that can leverage command shells including Z Shell (zsh). | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has gained initial access by exploiting privilege escalation vulnerabilities in the operating system or network services. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has used commercial tools, LOTL utilities, and appliances already present on the system for group and user discovery. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has run `net localgroup administrators` in compromised environments to enumerate accounts. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has run `net group` in compromised environments to discover domain groups. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has run `rd /S` to delete their working directories and deleted systeminfo.dat from `C:\Users\Public\Documentsfiles`. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has inspected server logs to remove their IPs. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has staged collected data in password-protected archives. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has saved stolen files including the `ntds.dit` database and the `SYSTEM` and `SECURITY` Registry hives locally to the `C:\Windows\Temp\` directory. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon relies primarily on valid credentials for persistence. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has used compromised domain accounts to authenticate to devices on compromised networks. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has enumerated directories containing vulnerability testing and cyber related content and facilities data such as construction drawings. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has executed `net user` and `quser` to enumerate local account information. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has run `net group /dom` and `net group "Domain Admins" /dom` in compromised environments for account discovery. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has used compromised devices and customized versions of open source tools such as FRP (Fast Reverse Proxy), Earthworm, and Impacket to proxy network traffic. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has used the built-in netsh `port proxy` command to create proxies on compromised systems to facilitate access. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has used multi-hop proxies for command-and-control infrastructure. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has downloaded an outdated version of comsvcs.dll to a compromised domain controller in a non-standard folder. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has used `netsh` to create a PortProxy Registry modification on a compromised server running the Paessler Router Traffic Grapher (PRTG). | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has obtained a screenshot of the victim's system using the gdi32.dll and gdiplus.dll libraries. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has obtained victim's screen dimension and display device information. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has obtained the victim's system timezone. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has used VPNs to connect to victim environments and enable post-exploitation actions. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has used Base64-encoded data to transfer payloads and commands, including deobfuscation via certutil. | cobertura: regra

Volt Typhoon has used webshells, including ones named AuditReport.jspx and iisstart.aspx, in compromised environments. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has queried the Registry on compromised systems for information on installed software. | cobertura: regra
Volt Typhoon has obtained credentials insecurely stored on targeted network appliances. | cobertura: regra

Volt Typhoon has targeted network administrator browser data including browsing history and stored credentials. | cobertura: regra

Volt Typhoon has copied web shells between servers in targeted environments. | cobertura: regra

Volt Typhoon has used compromised Paessler Router Traffic Grapher (PRTG) servers from other organizations for C2. | cobertura: regra
